journal.decision: Honor progression policy v3: keep Woodcutting as Cleo's active locked skill until authoritative level 99 or explicit Noot change. Continue the proven Edgeville yew method in bounded verified capacity batches, banking every useful log and changing location/tool rather than skill on contention or method failure. Service any exact active Cleo handoff first. Keep earth-runes as the single shared faction resource priority, but do not interrupt the active Woodcutting lock or consume CleoSupply's private 10000-essence stockpile without an exact accepted handoff. Combat and Prayer are not part of the linear skill-to-99 queue; they require a separate monster-and-loot progression doctrine.
journal.rationale: The turn began under progression policy v2 and completed a verified exact one-sapphire Crafting 36 finish. A second sapphire stockpile attempt encountered zero shop stock and safely recovered; its private sale realized 175 coins and was not counted as quartermaster revenue. Mid-turn, cleo-progression-policy.json durably changed to v3, locking Woodcutting until 99 and explicitly approving a permanent Steel axe handoff from CleoSupply. The first dedicated handoff ticket failed without transfer; the non-duplicated replacement ticket cleo-steel-axe-002 completed with exact two-sided trade evidence. Two verified Edgeville yew batches then raised Woodcutting from 65 to 74 and banked 19 additional Yew logs. Cleo ended alive, full HP, inventory empty, bank open at Edgeville, with the Steel axe equipped and Attack unchanged.
journal.outcome: 100% confidence · Refresh coordination first. If no exact active Cleo operation exists, run another bounded, policy-scouted Edgeville yew capacity batch with the equipped Steel axe, then verify XP, logs, lifeId, Attack freeze, bank, and the Woodcutting-99 campaign artifact.
